title: SymetriqueDataTasks
summary: A collection of Jupyter notebooks that process healthcare claims datasets (inpatient, hospice, SNF) and generate synthetic versions of them. Each notebook uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata alongside CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic tabular data from the claims dataframes.
evidence: inpatient.ipynb:394 'model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=100)\n' followed by model.fit(claim_df)
